# 10 — Defenders, and what is fair

*Written by the suite from [`tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd`](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd). Every line under **What the suite asserts** is the name of a test that runs on every pull request, and its link is the assertion.*

The fairness rules of §3, as tests rather than as prose.

"Defenders are fair" is the load-bearing claim of the whole defense design:
§9 rates "defenders feel random or unfair" as a High risk, and the mitigation
it names is the fairness rules plus determinism. Prose cannot enforce either.
Each rule below is one test, and each one should fail loudly if a later sport
or a difficulty pass quietly breaks it.

## What the suite asserts

- [A defender telegraphs before it acts](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L48)
- [The tell lasts as long as the profile promises](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L62)
- [No tier can shorten the tell below the readable floor](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L75)
- [A defender cannot act twice without cooling down](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L86)
- [A low shot goes under the shooter](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L104)
- [A shot that peaks outside the zone is not reachable](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L115)
- [Curve does not move the apex out of the zone it spoils the aim](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L127)
- [Accuracy falls off toward the rim of the zone](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L157)
- [A harder tier never widens what counts as low](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L170)
- [The same seed and the same arc give the same verdict](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L183)
- [Two defenders on one hole roll independently](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L195)
- [Hit rate tracks the tier](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L214)
- [The brain never draws from the global rng](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L230)
- [The brain cannot be told what the player intended](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L243)
- [A defender beaten for speed does not get to act late](../tests/defenders/test_defender_brain.gd#L257)
